text:
maria: Quick sync — I'm proposing a small change to the chat/completions streaming payloads.

maria: TL;DR: add a top-level "delta_type" (e.g. "content" | "metadata" | "tool_call") for streaming chunks and change function_call.arguments from a JSON-encoded string to a real JSON object. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/412

josh: Hmm, how do we detect old clients vs new? Backcompat concern.

maria: Plan is: keep both shapes for a transition window. If "function_call.arguments" is a string, treat as legacy; if object, parse directly. For streaming, "delta_type" will be optional — if missing, infer from fields but warn in logs.

josh: Example old streaming chunk:
```
{"id":"abc","type":"delta","delta":{"role":"assistant","content":"Hi"}}
```
New chunk:
```
{"id":"abc","type":"delta","delta_type":"content","role":"assistant","content":"Hi"}
```

sam: For function_call the old vs new:
Old:
```
{"function_call":{"name":"get_weather","arguments":"{\"city\":\"NYC\"}"}}
```
New:
```
{"function_call":{"name":"get_weather","arguments":{"city":"NYC"}}}
```

sam: SDKs will need to accept both; recommend adding a serializer helper and unit tests.

ciara: Evals depend on exact token streaming shape. We should add a regression harness that replays recorded streams and asserts semantic parity.

maria: Agreed. Also adding an API version header 'X-Redwood-API-Version: 2026-11-01' on the PR for canary.

josh: Also check websocket framing — some clients expect `data: {...}\n\n` chunks. We can't break that. Keep framing identical.

sam: +1 to a feature flag and a 2-week canary before full rollout. I'll add infra playbook steps.

deploy-bot: CI ✅ 6 checks passed. Staging deploy queued.

ciara: One more: tool_call delta_type should carry partial args streaming, e.g. multiple delta events that append to arguments. Agree?

maria: Yes — delta_type = "tool_call" with fields {"name":..., "arguments_fragment": ...} and the final chunk will include arguments_complete: true. We'll document.

josh: Sounds good. I'll review the PR and add comments about test coverage.

maria: Thanks — tagging @sam for SDK follow-up and @ciara for eval harness. :thumbsup:

sam: On it. Will open follow-up PRs for python/js SDKs.

ciara: I'll add an eval job to the nightly suite.

maria: cool, I'll merge once canary looks good.
